summary: Completed testing of branding features (logo upload, color customization) and PDF generation with logo/QR code. Backend: 11/12 tests passed (1 skipped - no paid factures). Frontend: All branding UI elements working correctly, CSS variable injection verified.
critical_code_review_comments: PDF generator correctly loads logo from entreprise.logo_url using load_logo_image() function
QR code generation for unpaid factures works via generate_qr_code() function
Paid factures show 'PAYÉE' text instead of QR code (correct behavior)
AuthContext.jsx correctly injects CSS variables (--tenant-primary, --primary, --tenant-primary-rgb) when entreprise.couleur_primaire changes
Branding API endpoints properly validate hex color format (#RRGGBB)
Logo upload restricted to admin role only
Settings page branding tab has all required elements: logo upload, color picker, color presets, preview section
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ prefixed devis and factures during backend testing (cleaned up after tests)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Branding features fully tested. Key findings: 1) Logo upload works via POST /api/entreprise/logo (admin only), 2) Color change works via PUT /api/entreprise/branding?couleur_primaire=#RRGGBB, 3) CSS variables are dynamically injected in AuthContext when entreprise.couleur_primaire changes, 4) PDF generation includes logo (if set) and QR code for unpaid factures. Note: Test tenant 'Test Plomberie SAS' currently has no logo_url set - upload a logo via Settings > Personnalisation to test logo in PDFs.
